question:
You've said several times that you think being eaten by small creatures would be the scariest way to die. Do you plan on having Subaru eaten by small animals again?

Would doing it in the same way as a death we've already seen make it less frightening because the sense of fear wouldn't be as fresh?
answer:
I've always had this very primal fear that being eaten by small creatures would be terrifying.

The reason is that, in one of the Jurassic Park movies, there was a scene where someone was separated from the rest of an expedition and then chased down and killed by a group of small dinosaurs. Ever since then, I've been afraid of being swarmed by small creatures, so I tried it out on Subaru with the Great Rabbit... (laughs)

That said, the Great Rabbit is one of the Three Great Mabeasts, so I have the basic feeling that it's difficult to create something more impactful than the Great Rabbit in terms of how Subaru is broken. However, the image of being eaten by insects is a little different from that, so there may be an opportunity for that to happen someday. Dragonflies are scary...
